candidates.title: Kenya's fertility rate falls to 3.1 children per woman; 32.9% of women 15-49 never married (2025-26 KNBS Mini DHS) — Africa Uncensored
candidates.snippet: Africa Uncensored (@AfUncensored): Kenya's fertility rate has fallen to 3.1 children per woman, and 32.9% of women aged 15-49 have never married, per new 2025-26 KNBS Mini DHS data.
